results.name: Cinematic Mode activates via ◉ CINEMATIC VIEW toolbar button
results.detail: Button '◉ CINEMATIC VIEW' sets body.cinematic-mode and hides #top-bar, #left-panel, #right-panel, #bottom-bar, #labels-layer, #demo-banner, and #hover-tooltip.

results.name: Keyboard shortcut H hides the complete interface
Keyboard shortcut H restores the complete interface
results.detail: Pressing H again cleanly exits cinematic-mode and restores all HUD panels.

results.name: Escape key restores interface with safe modal priority
results.detail: Escape closes open modal first if present, and restores the interface from cinematic mode.

results.name: Floating SHOW INTERFACE control (reveal, 2.5s auto-fade, click restore, canvas isolation)
results.detail: Revealed on mousemove=True, canvas click isolated=True, auto-faded after 2.5s=True, restored on click=True.

results.name: 3D canvas and orbital simulation continue running in Cinematic Mode
results.detail: Simulation time and planetary rotation advance normally (468 WebGL draw calls per frame).

results.name: Camera orbit, zoom, and free-flight remain active in Cinematic Mode
results.detail: OrbitControls and WASD navigation operate seamlessly with HUD hidden.

results.name: Fullscreen and Cinematic Mode operate independently
results.detail: Toggling fullscreen preserves cinematicMode state independently.

results.name: All 9 original application modes preserved and functional
results.detail: Verified HOME, SOLAR_SYSTEM, PLANETS, MOONS, DEEP_SPACE, MISSIONS, LABORATORY, KNOWLEDGE, and SETTINGS.

results.name: All original keyboard shortcuts (Space, R, F, 1–5, Esc) preserved
results.detail: Verified Space play/pause, 1–5 view presets, and R camera reset.

results.name: Sun granulation/corona/prominences & Earth cloud layer/night-lights/Fresnel rim
results.detail: Sun: chromosphere + 3 corona shells + 4 plasma prominence arches; Earth: independent cloud sphere + night-side city lights + Fresnel rim.

results.name: Saturn multi-layered high-resolution ring system
results.detail: Saturn has 2 ring mesh layers with 512px radial division/ringlet texture (D, C, B, Cassini, A, Encke, Keeler, F).

results.name: Multi-layer spectral starfield with scintillation & shooting stars
results.detail: 3 spectral depth/twinkle star layers + subtle background shooting star.

results.name: Moon & Deep Space morphological visual upgrades
results.detail: Custom procedural textures for all 18 moons, Titan orange haze shell, and morphological 3D structures for Milky Way, Andromeda, Pillars of Creation, Crab, and Orion.

results.name: Adaptive LOW, MEDIUM, and HIGH graphics presets
results.detail: LOW (256px tex, 1600 stars), MEDIUM (512px tex, 3800 stars), HIGH (1024px tex, 6800 stars).

results.name: Laptop-friendly memory & triangle budget (HP ProBook 640 safe)
results.detail: Triangles: 131388, Draw calls: 768, JS Heap: 12 MB

results.name: 100% Offline — Zero external runtime network requests
